title: •Quick Draw
caption: •Quick Draw (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Your lightsabers are destiny +2 and may target vehicles using 1 Force (each destiny draw is -2). If your character weapon (except a grenade) just lost, may use 1 Force to place that weapon in Used Pile. Once per game, may ▼ Sai’torr Kal Fas. {alter}
lore: It’s high noon on Dagobah, his droid’s reined in and Luke’s got a fistful of credits.

notes: UNIQUENESS: the slip's heading and caption print • (stub Unique) but the printed card is not unique ('Quick Draw', wiki Unrestricted) — title kept as printed (no dot), caption as the slip; caller to decide whether the remaster title gains the dot (cf. the Defensive Shield rule). Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. ▼ where the stub expands the phrase; curly apostrophe in Sai’torr; red circle-slash A → {alter}. Margin credits: left 'Original concept by Lee Edwards', right 'Florida State Winner 2004'. Lore: curly apostrophes (It’s, droid’s, Luke’s); otherwise matches. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright per Dagobah convention. Modern: Virtual Block 4 only (VB4 -pre, 350 px).
